title: Retire duplicate Home Assistant fleet Ansible/Nomad authority

classification_notes.migrate: Already present (exact or transformed) under aleksclark/fleet-iac; remove executable duplicate from home_assist.
classification_notes.retire: No deploy path remains; deleted from home_assist without a same-shape canonical successor (or project-owned elsewhere). Includes stock-unit enablement symlinks intentionally retired with canonical:null when fleet-iac has no unique source.
classification_notes.retain-non-authoritative: Kept only when unique non-executable documentation/reference remains. forbidden_reintroduction.note: Any tracked or untracked path under fleet/ other than the exact allowlist fails closed (case-sensitive; no prefix widen; symlinks included).
